name: Tasselwrath
description: Opens with a rising cut from each edge in turn like a salute offered to a paired opponent.

name: Eddyflash
description: Steps to the second of two seats placed across the court from the opponent.

name: Impenetrable Guardwing
description: Holds two guard lines in a mirrored pair to cover both sides of the body.

name: Decimating Springtip
description: Thrusts the point to the spot where the opponent's own point would land.

name: Unbowed Jianhilt
description: Parries with one edge then turns the blade over to parry again with the other.

name: Overbearing Twinspine
description: Binds the opposing blade between the jian and the free sword fingers like a pair of tongs.

name: Eviscerating Flitter
description: Thrusts twice along crossing lines so the second point enters where the first parried.

name: Obdurate Pommeltuft
description: Parries in one arc and reverses along the opposite arc into a cut at the opponent.

name: Shattering Tempered Twinspine
description: Cuts from both sides in one instant so that a guard holding either side leaves the other open.

name: Invincible Ridgecrest
description: Holds a high guard on the rim of the practice ground and watches the floor below.

name: Liltglimmer
description: Circles the opponent at a wide radius with the blade held high and still.

name: Tasselruin
description: Cuts from behind the opponent's shadow so the first sign of the blade is its landing.

name: Clairvoyant Knotcord
description: Reads every shift of the opponent's weight on the ground from the circling height.

name: Berserk Flitter
description: Dives from the circle into a short poke at the opponent's sword hand and rises again.

name: Lilthavoc
description: Rises on a surge of qi into a slash that cuts upward across the guard.

name: Impervious Waistbend
description: Gathers the opposing cut into a bowl-shaped parry and tips it out to the side.

name: Strangling Flexspine
description: Circles to the opponent's blind side and spoils the opponent's turn with a flat strike.

name: Ferocious Springtip
description: Plunges from the circling height onto the opponent's guard with the point leading.

name: Mayhem Ridgecrest
description: Spreads both arms and sweeps the edge through a wide arc to clear all foes ahead.

name: Glintswirl
description: Falls from a leap with the full dive of a hawk so the point passes through any guard.

name: Grievous Twinspine
description: Draws the cut across the opponent on the first breath and returns it on the second.

name: Driftglare
description: Times each step to the beat of the heart so the body never breaks rhythm.

name: Unassailable Springtip
description: Holds the guard and the breath together so the blade stays still under pressure.

name: Prescient Knotcord
description: Reads the opponent's heart beat through the tremor in the opposing blade.

name: Pitiless Flitter
description: Thrusts on the out-breath of the opponent when the guard is lowest.

name: Flintlike Guardwing
description: Parries on the beat that falls between the opponent's heart and breath.

name: Galvanizing Pommeltuft
description: Sends two pulses of qi into the sword arm in pairs to speed the next cut.

name: Rampaging Swirl
description: Chains slashes one to a breath without a pause until the opponent's guard fails.

name: Hogtying Ridgecrest
description: Locks the opposing blade on the beat of the opponent's own heart.

name: Devastating Sanguine Ridgecrest
description: Cuts at the instant breath and heartbeat and step fall together so nothing in the stroke is wasted.

name: Booming Waistbend
description: Flicks a quick cut from the wrist like water welling from a spring.

name: Rippleflash
description: Steps in a thin winding line like a rill finding its way through stones.

name: Evergreen Guardwing
description: Guards with the blade slanted across the body so cuts run off to the side.

name: Unerring Tassel
description: Feels the ground under both stances for loose footing before committing a step.

name: Driftwrath
description: Jabs the point at the opponent's wrist in a small quick throw like a pebble.

name: Rippleruin
description: Joins a second side cut to the main cut so the two meet in the opponent's guard.

name: Obdurate Jianhilt
description: Turns the opposing blade around a small whirl of the wrist and out of line.

name: Brutalizing Swirl
description: Drives a fast narrow thrust that gains speed down a channel between two guards.

name: Webbing Springtip
description: Spreads the blade in a fan of small binds that catch the opposing sword at several points.

name: Mangling Lilt
description: Slashes in a slow broad sweep that gathers weight across the whole length of the pass.

name: Siltswirl
description: Spreads a wide surge of qi from the blade that washes over every foe before the swordsman.

name: Vengeful Tassel
description: Chains a cut for each stage of a river's course into one stroke that grows heavier to its end.

name: Eddyruin
description: Draws a long flat cut along the horizontal line of the opponent's shoulders.

name: Flexblink
description: Takes a light quick step in the half-seen moment before the opponent can react.

name: Indomitable Twinspine
description: Guards by holding the blade out at arm's length to keep the opponent far away.

name: Punishing Springtip
description: Thrusts out to full reach and returns to guard before the opponent can answer.

name: Adamantine Knotcord
description: Parries with a thin feathered sweep of the edge that barely touches the opposing blade.

name: Reverie Pommeltuft
description: Blurs the blade's outline with fast small motions so the true cut cannot be read.

name: Corroding Flexspine
description: Brings the edge down from the highest point of the swing onto the opponent's crown.

name: Blistering Swirl
description: Sweeps the blade through a full half circle that cuts all foes along the front.

name: Unsparing Tassel
description: Cuts along a line that seems to run to the horizon and parts whatever stands across it.

name: Willowhavoc
description: Cuts from one side as a partner cuts from the other at the same moment.

name: Vigilant Ridgecrest
description: Marks the prey's weak side with the eye and shares the mark with the partner.

name: Willowblink
description: Steps in time with a partner so the two swordsmen keep the prey between them.

name: Unconquered Guardwing
description: Stands back to back with a partner so one blade covers what the other cannot.

name: Titanic Flitter
description: Thrusts in a stoop while a partner thrusts from the opposite side.

name: Impenetrable Waistbend
description: Parries a cut meant for a partner and returns to guard in the same turn.

name: Liltscourge
description: Slashes across the prey's turning path as the partner drives it round.

name: Decimating Eddy
description: Cuts in a pair of crossing strokes with a partner so the edges meet at the prey.

name: Harnessing Knotcord
description: Binds the prey's blade and walks it toward the partner's waiting point.

name: Ferocious Ripple
description: Dives with a partner from opposite heights in one thrust that ends the hunt.

name: Pitiless Waistbend
description: Cuts low from a deep stance with the edge skimming the floor of the stance.

name: Tasselvortex
description: Climbs forward in short level stages like a terrace up a slope.

name: Impervious Ridgecrest
description: Rings the body with the blade in a slow circle so no cut finds an unguarded edge.

name: Radiant Knotcord
description: Reads all of the opponent's blade lines at once as a catchment reads rain.

name: Driftscourge
description: Thrusts upward from the lowest point of the stance at the opponent's belly.

name: Swirlruin
description: Lets the gathered force of a parry spill out in a slash across the opponent.

name: Immobilizing Guardwing
description: Settles the blade over the opposing sword so slowly that it cannot be lifted free.

name: Unrelenting Twinspine
description: Takes an incoming cut into a bowl-shaped parry that drains its force.

name: Ripplewrath
description: Draws the cut across the opponent after holding back qi until the pass is complete.

name: Mangling Springtip
description: Spreads a low broad slash across the full width of the opponent's footing.

name: Rampaging Flitter
description: Gathers the force of the whole stance into one thrust released at a single point.

name: Lacerating Swirl
description: Rends the opponent from the highest guard to the lowest in one descending pass.

name: Titanic Slag Waistbend
description: Releases everything gathered in the basin of the stance in one cut that reaches every foe nearby.

name: Swirlwrath
description: Cuts in a light spiraling drop like a leaf settling toward the ground.

name: Tasselglare
description: Steps lightly across brittle ground without a sound of the foot.

name: Unbudging Guardwing
description: Holds the blade still and cold across the body until an attack is committed.

name: Illuminating Pommeltuft
description: Reads the opponent's motion through small changes in the cool air on the skin.

name: Vengeful Springtip
description: Reaps a single thrust at the end of a long patient wait for the opening.

name: Evergreen Jianhilt
description: Parries once with the body track and again with the qi track in the same moment.

name: Flexwrath
description: Slashes in a drifting descent that is too slow to read and too heavy to stop.

name: Overpowering Knotcord
description: Binds the opposing blade between the swordsman's two qi tracks like two seasons meeting.

name: Merciless Lilt
description: Thrusts with the whole stored patience of the season into one narrow point.

name: Punishing Swirl
description: Sweeps a cold flat cut across the opponent's hands that numbs the grip.

name: Berserk Eddy
description: Reaps a cut where body track and qi track arrive together and cannot be parried apart.

name: Willowscourge
description: Cuts in time with the spoken oath so the stroke carries the weight of the word.

name: Flexflash
description: Plants each step as if swearing to hold that ground against the wind.

name: Obdurate Ridgecrest
description: Guards the body with the blade and the oath held in mind through the blow.

name: Vigilant Twinspine
description: Fixes the vowed bearing toward the opponent through every shift of the wind.

name: Swirlhavoc
description: Thrusts along the vowed line so the oath keeps the point from straying.

name: Unbowed Knotcord
description: Parries by turning the blade into the wind as a witness turns toward a speaker.

name: Maiming Guardwing
description: Holds the opposing blade in a bind for as long as the oath is held in the mind.

name: Wrathful Lilt
description: Slashes with the felt weight of the oath behind the edge so it will not be turned.

name: Unsparing Springtip
description: Thrusts on a line the swordsman has sworn not to leave under any blow.

name: Hellish Tassel
description: Cuts once on a sworn line so true that the wind itself parts around the edge.

name: Gust Waistbend
description: Cuts along the plateau rim while the gale pushes the blade toward the opponent.

name: Driftvortex
description: Runs forward on level high ground with the gale at the back.

name: Impenetrable Flexspine
description: Braces the stance and holds the guard against the full push of the gale.

name: Eddyscourge
description: Times a thrust to a rim gust so the point arrives with the push of wind.

name: Inexorable Pommeltuft
description: Parries as the gale breaks against the blade so the opposing cut loses its line.

name: Murk Guardwing
description: Flicks the blade through the ground dust to raise a veil that hides the next cut.

name: Berserk Springtip
description: Charges down the wind in a thrust that grows faster along its whole length.

name: Blazelilt
description: Sweeps a gust of qi across the open ground that cuts every foe in its path.

name: Titanic Eddy
description: Rends the opposing guard with a cut that carries the whole force of the plateau gale.

name: Brutalizing Twinspine
description: Cuts outward along a bearing fixed on the opponent before the swing begins.

name: Swirlglimmer
description: Steps back along the same course that the advance took to the opponent.

name: Unerring Guardwing
description: Fixes the opponent's position against a distant mark to hold the bearing steady.

name: Flintlike Springtip
description: Sets the guard along the bearing so cuts must cross it to reach the body.

name: Ripplescourge
description: Thrusts on the return leg of a step while the opponent expects the retreat.

name: Flexscourge
description: Corrects a cut mid-stroke for a crosswind so the edge still lands on the bearing.

name: Unassailable Pommeltuft
description: Parries on the return leg of a step and pushes the opposing blade back.

name: Flexruin
description: Reverses the bearing mid-pass and slashes back along the line just traveled.

name: Suffocating Jianhilt
description: Holds the opponent's blade on a fixed course until the swordsman chooses to release it.

name: Corroding Springtip
description: Thrusts out on a bearing then drives back along it in a long second thrust.

name: Rampaging Ripple
description: Sweeps out along a bearing and sweeps back along it without a pause between them.

name: Merciless Eddy
description: Cuts out and returns by the same bearing in one motion so the second cut lands where the first opened.

name: Pitiless Twinspine
description: Cuts on bare level ground where the opponent has nothing to step behind.

name: Flexglare
description: Steps along the skyline of a ridge so the outline of the body shifts quickly.

name: Indomitable Waistbend
description: Guards in the open by turning the body edge-on to the opponent.

name: Clairvoyant Tassel
description: Reads the bending of the far grass to learn which way the opponent will move.

name: Titanic Swirl
description: Thrusts across a long flat space with the point rising slightly at the end.

name: Liltruin
description: Slashes from the very end of reach with no wall to limit the swing.

name: Adamantine Guardwing
description: Parries and gives ground in a wide step because there is room to spare.

name: Strangling Jianhilt
description: Binds the opposing blade and turns the opponent to face the open drop.

name: Mangling Flitter
description: Thrusts across the full width of the open plateau with nothing in the way.

name: Mayhem Pommeltuft
description: Rolls a low sweep across the ground that cuts every foe along the front.

name: Ferocious Gust Springtip
description: Strikes from open ground with the whole plateau behind the stride and no guard to stop it.

name: Booming Ridgecrest
description: Leaps into the gale and cuts as it lifts the body off the ground.

name: Eddyvortex
description: Steps onto an updraft that carries the body a hand's breadth higher.

name: Unconquered Waistbend
description: Holds the guard low and leaning like a rider crouched against the gale.

name: Prescient Pommeltuft
description: Leans into the gale to feel how the opponent's body shapes the air.

name: Liltwrath
description: Thrusts with the wind at the back so the point gains speed through the extension.

name: Unrelenting Guardwing
description: Parries into the wind so the opposing cut slows at the very point of contact.

name: Shattering Flexspine
description: Slashes sideways on the gust so the blade curves around the opposing guard.

name: Vengeful Flitter
description: Surges forward on a burst of gale in a thrust that outruns the guard.

name: Rampaging Tassel
description: Spins past the opponent on the wind and cuts as the turn completes.

name: Punishing Ripple
description: Rides one surge of the gale past the guard so the blade passes through it and the swordsman lands behind.

name: Wrathful Springtip
description: Answers an attack with a cut at the same height on the same line.

name: Flexglimmer
description: Echoes the opponent's step with a matching step so the distance never changes.

name: Evergreen Twinspine
description: Guards so that the blade is already moving to answer when the cut arrives.

name: Ripplehavoc
description: Replies to a thrust with a thrust that crosses it and lands first.

name: Impervious Jianhilt
description: Parries and sends the opposing force back along the path it came.

name: Overbearing Knotcord
description: Binds the opposing blade in the same way it was bound a moment before.

name: Gnashing Swirl
description: Thrusts at the instant the opponent commits and arrives with equal and greater speed.

name: Eviscerating Tassel
description: Slashes back with the same cut the opponent made but a breath faster.

name: Ruinous Eddy
description: Meets the opponent's strongest attack with one cut that answers it exactly and passes through.

name: Eddyhavoc
description: Drops down a ledge and cuts as the weight lands.

name: Driftblink
description: Climbs a ledge in one step with the blade held steady.

name: Unbudging Springtip
description: Holds a low guard while gripping the ground with the toes like a ledge.

name: Unerring Knotcord
description: Reads the fall line of the slope to know where the opponent's weight will go.

name: Corroding Flitter
description: Thrusts upward while climbing the last hand of a ledge.

name: Swirlscourge
description: Springs off a ledge and slashes in the air above the opponent's guard.

name: Obdurate Twinspine
description: Parries while dropping into a crouch so the cut passes overhead.

name: Enthralling Waistbend
description: Binds the opposing blade low then lifts it high to pull the opponent off balance.

name: Grievous Lilt
description: Climbs the opponent's guard with the point and thrusts at the top of the rise.

name: Brutalizing Ripple
description: Chops downward from a full leap with the weight of a falling body.

name: Booming Eddy
description: Cuts downward in a fall then upward in a rise so one stroke covers both lines.

name: Punishing Tassel
description: Cuts slowly with the full weight of the body held behind the sworn word.

name: Willowflash
description: Steps with the weight of a boulder so each foot lands as a statement.

name: Impenetrable Pommeltuft
description: Braces the guard so the blade will not give ground under a blow.

name: Radiant Tassel
description: Feels the weight of the opposing blade through the contact of the edges.

name: Ferocious Flitter
description: Loads the thrust slowly then releases it with the full burden of the stance.

name: Inexorable Ridgecrest
description: Turns an opposing cut aside with a weighted sweep that costs the opponent his balance.

name: Numbing Knotcord
description: Presses the blade down on the opposing sword with the weight of the whole stance.

name: Willowwrath
description: Shifts the weight from foot to foot during a slash so it grows heavier as it lands.

name: Lacerating Eddy
description: Lifts the opposing blade with the edge and cuts as it rises.

name: Berserk Swirl
description: Thrusts with the full sworn weight so the point does not slow in armor.

name: Merciless Ripple
description: Slashes with the weight of the vow behind the arm and a long follow-through.

name: Silt Flexspine
description: Sweeps the blade in a long weighted arc that cuts every foe in front of the swordsman.

name: Grievous Might Knotcord
description: Brings down one cut with the entire sworn weight of the stance that cannot be turned aside.
